description: This file defines the CrossPlatformInputManager class for handling cross-platform input in Unity, including virtual axes and buttons, input switching, and platform-specific input handling.

classes.name: CrossPlatformInputManager
classes.description: Static class managing cross-platform input, virtual axes, and buttons, with platform-specific input switching.

classes.name: CrossPlatformInputManager.VirtualAxis
classes.description: Represents a virtual axis that can be updated and queried.

classes.name: CrossPlatformInputManager.VirtualButton
classes.description: Represents a virtual button with press/release states.

methods.name: SwitchActiveInputMethod
methods.description: Switches the active input method between hardware and touch.

methods.name: AxisExists
methods.description: Checks if a virtual axis exists.

methods.name: ButtonExists
methods.description: Checks if a virtual button exists.

methods.name: RegisterVirtualAxis
methods.description: Registers a new virtual axis.

methods.name: RegisterVirtualButton
methods.description: Registers a new virtual button.

methods.name: UnRegisterVirtualAxis
methods.description: Unregisters a virtual axis by name.

methods.name: UnRegisterVirtualButton
methods.description: Unregisters a virtual button by name.

methods.name: VirtualAxisReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to a virtual axis.

methods.name: GetAxis
methods.description: Gets the value of an axis.

methods.name: GetAxisRaw
methods.description: Gets the raw value of an axis.

methods.name: GetButton
methods.description: Checks if a button is pressed.

methods.name: GetButtonDown
methods.description: Checks if a button was pressed this frame.

methods.name: GetButtonUp
methods.description: Checks if a button was released this frame.

methods.name: SetButtonDown
methods.description: Simulates button press.

methods.name: SetButtonUp
methods.description: Simulates button release.

methods.name: SetAxisPositive
methods.description: Sets axis to positive direction.

methods.name: SetAxisNegative
methods.description: Sets axis to negative direction.

methods.name: SetAxisZero
methods.description: Resets axis to zero.

methods.name: SetAxis
methods.description: Sets axis to a specific value.

methods.name: MousePosition
methods.description: Gets the current mouse position.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionX
methods.description: Sets virtual mouse X position.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionY
methods.description: Sets virtual mouse Y position.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionZ
methods.description: Sets virtual mouse Z position.
